verdict.rationale: Browser Use clearly runs versioned APIs: OpenAPI specs are published for v2, v3 and v4, the v4 server path is /api/v4 with version 4.0.0, and the docs give guidance on choosing V4 versus V3. No evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or migration guarantees, so only half the story is covered. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, version support windows, migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
